The candidate 안할듯 parses as 안 하-ㄹ + dependent noun 듯; the comparator's t͈ matches the standard connected reading, while Kozak's d is lenis. Rule 27 notes that a pause can license the plain consonant; the corpus text has no pause marker, so this adjudication is limited to the standard connected reading and is not token-specific acoustic proof.
